bg.$description: Base fill of the decorative loading shapes.

bg-image.$description: Optional image layered over the static fill. Defaults to none.

backdrop-filter.$description: Complete backdrop filter behind a loading shape. Defaults to none.

highlight.$description: Peak colour of the animated loading highlight.

radius.$description: Corner radius of text lines and rectangles.

circle-radius.$description: Proportional corner radius of the circular shape.

line-size.$description: Default height of each text line.

last-line-scale.$description: Fraction of the usual line width occupied by the final line in multiline text.

rect-size.$description: Default block size of the rectangle.

shimmer-image.$description: Image of the moving highlight. Use currentColor to inherit the highlight colour.
